articles.title: NASA announces major overhaul of Artemis moon program:  “We’ve got to get back to basics”
articles.summary: New NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman announced a major overhaul of the agency's Artemis moon program Friday, acknowledging that the agency's plan to land astronauts on the moon in 2028 was not realistic without another preparatory mission first to lay the groundwork.

articles.title: NASA’s Home for Experimental Flight Advances Aeronautics Mission
articles.summary: Nestled in the Mojave Desert, NASA’s Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California, pushes the boundaries of flight to advance the agency’s aeronautics mission. This is where Chuck Yeager broke the sound barrier and engineers are now pioneering the future of high-speed, autonomous, and electrified aircraft. articles.title: NASA Adds Mission to Artemis Lunar Program, Updates Architecture

articles.title: NASA revises plans for future Artemis missions, cancels upgrades to SLS
articles.summary:
NASA announced major changes to its Artemis lunar architecture, adding a test flight of lunar landers in low Earth orbit while canceling planned upgrades to the Space Launch System.
